description: E-433 (D-160; .ai/blueprints/release-artifact.md §Component 7; docs/app-contract.md 'Pane options'): the tmux pane options an app reads, with the closed value list of each. Values may be added inside a major version (the minor, before 1.0.0), never removed; a reader treats any non-empty @rein_waiting as waiting and reads it only when @rein_signals contains `waiting`. tests/unit/waiting-signal.test.mjs fails when src/shared/waiting-signal.sh can write a name or value this file does not list.
